# DPO Central community edition

> Open-source privacy program records for GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA and other US state laws: data inventory and records of processing (ROPA), rights requests (DSAR), vendor register and breach register. Self-hosted, AGPL-3.0-or-later.

The DPO Central community edition is software you install and run yourself (Docker or Node.js with PostgreSQL). It keeps the records a privacy program runs on, in English and Spanish:

- Data inventory: systems, data elements, processing activities, data flows and a data map; cross-border transfers with their mechanism and status.
- Records of processing (GDPR Art. 30): controller and processor records, exported as PDF, CSV, XLSX or JSON.
- Rights requests: a public request form per organization, deadlines by jurisdiction, tasks, messages and retention-based redaction.
- Vendors: vendor register, contracts and periodic reviews, exported as PDF or CSV.
- Breach register: incidents, timelines, notification deadlines by jurisdiction and the register export.
- Organizations with members, five roles and departments; an audit trail.

It provides informational tools, not legal advice: verify outputs with qualified counsel before relying on them.

## Source

- [Source code](https://github.com/RINDOGATAN/dpocentral): AGPL-3.0-or-later. Installation in README.md (Docker in deploy/docker).
